    Tab navigation - Info panel version

    \r\n
    \r\n

    For setting .active class, please use Angular's built-in directive \r\n routerLinkActive. \r\n You just need to set up your child routes in your routing.module.ts and you're ready to go.

    \r\n

    For information regarding router-outlet implementation, please refer to the \r\n Angular documentation\r\n

    \r\n

    The Info panel version is designed to hold other components. In this example we have\r\n injected the progress-circle component. For progress-circle attributes please go here,\r\n for tooltip component please go here.\r\n
