Data list

\r\n
\r\n

The datalist tag specifies a list of pre-defined options for an input element.\r\n The datalist tag is used to provide an \"autocomplete\" feature for inputelements.\r\n Users will see a drop-down list of pre-defined options as they input data. The datalist\r\n element's id attribute must be equal to the input element's list\r\n attribute (this binds them together).

\r\n

\r\n

Standard select

\r\n
\r\n

The default value of the select element can be set \r\n by using the 'selected' attribute on the required option. \r\n This is a boolean attribute.

\r\n
\r\n
