Standard table with fixed header

\r\n
\r\n

For a scrollable table with a fixed header you will need to nest your table inside \r\n two div elements. Add the class .scroll-panel to the outer div and .scroll-panel-content \r\n to the inner div along with an [ngStyle] used to set the rem max-height. Then inside your \r\n table thead th cell, add a div with a nested span, inside this span add you cell text.\r\n
